title: Real-space spectral functions of three-dimensional billion-size topological non-Hermitian matter with tensor networks
summary: Non-Hermitian systems host unconventional topological phenomena, while real-space spectral calculations in three dimensions remain computationally challenging. Here, we develop a tensor-network framework that combines a quantics-based matrix-product-operator representation of large real-space tight-binding Hamiltonians with a non-Hermitian kernel polynomial method. The Hermitized spectral problem is retained within the compact tensor-network representation, enabling real-space spectral function calculations for systems exceeding one billion lattice sites.
